description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for managing videos, including listing, retrieving details, uploading, and streaming video files. It interacts with a database via SQLAlchemy models and handles file system operations for storing video files.

methods.name: str _safe_filename(name: str)
methods.description: Sanitizes filename strings to be filesystem-safe by removing disallowed characters.

methods.name: list_videos( session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional search string to filter by title"), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list videos, optionally filtering by a search query.

methods.name: get_video( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="ID of the video"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve detailed information for a specific video, including subtitles.

methods.name: upload_video( title: str = Query(..., description="Title for the uploaded video"), description: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional description"), file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Binary video file to upload"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload a new video, saving the file and creating a database record.

methods.name: stream_video( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="ID of the video to stream"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to stream the binary content of a specific video file.
